text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm in the cafeteria for my
break when I
see a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Nnngh... Hrrrmmm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Trainer. I'm Muddled Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want to do some cooking, but I can't
think of
anything to make. I'm just not
sure what to do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm. ♪ This smells wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, whenever I get a whiff of barbecue
sauce or
smell a charcoal grill, I can't
help but think of you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I picture your smile when you're grilling
meat, and
that surprised look on your
face when a drop of
oil leaps out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's a hoot and a half! I always think of you when I spot a sumo stew!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just the word "chanko" is cute as
anything, and
the stuff's so warm and
relaxing. Why, it's just like
you,
Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's like barbecue and chanko are
the
dishes that represent us!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh. That's given me some food for thought. Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I'm trying to think of a dish
that just
screams "Machan!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People do tend to associate others with
the foods
they like. It could make for a
good strategy to
have people remember
her, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But... it's proving to be pretty tough.
Should the
dish be something sweet or
salty?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hot? Or cold? I don't even know what
kind of
shape it should be. Would round
be good?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's so many options and yet none of
them
stand out to me. I'm stumped.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But! Now I have a decision-maker before
me!
Okay, Trainer. Please pick one dish
that reminds
you of me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. You're my trainer. Your eyes
are a lens
focused exclusively on me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you've had your eyes on me all this
time, you
should be able to think of a
Machan-esque food
right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And besides...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My dream might be to become an
internationally
beloved super ultra
mascot...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But if the person closest to me forgot
about me,
I'd feel like I'd gone wrong
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you can think of a dish that captures
who I am,
though, I think you'll
remember me for the rest of
your life.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So let's get right to it, Trainer. Tell me

straight—the dish I should make is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So let's get right to it, Trainer. Tell me

straight—the dish I should make is...
choice_data_list: 君の好きな食べ物にしよう
貴方の好きな食べ物にしよう
見た目にインパクトがあるものにしよう！

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh... And why's that?
choice_data_list: 君の好きな食べ物にしよう
貴方の好きな食べ物にしよう
見た目にインパクトがあるものにしよう！

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. Okay, in that case, let's go
with what I
like.
choice_data_list: 君が好きだと思えばより記憶に残るから
貴方が好きだと思えばより記憶に残るから

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yes. My favorite food would have
to be fish
and chips.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I had some with my father in England a
long time
ago. When I found out how
much he liked fish and
chips, the meal
tasted even better...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Interesting. Maybe we are more likely to remember the things that the people we like are into.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan and I cook up
some fish
and chips...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boy howdy, what's that smell?! I think
my sniffer
died and went to heaven!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right, that smells wonderful.
What are you
cooking, Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Are you curious? Would you like
to know?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, help yourselves. This is a feast to
be
remembered. Let's eat up together
and make
some unforgettable memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These fries taste incredible. They're so
light and
fluffy. I feel like I'll remember
this taste forever.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, I know just the thing.
Trainer,
please go and buy me some fish
as soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to create a masterpiece so
striking that
you'll remember it for the
rest of your life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, Aston Machan and I are
cooking
together.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Machan! Thanks for reaching out.
I'm here to
grub up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what this unforgettable snack
could be?
I've really been looking
forward to it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki and Bono
text_block_list.text: What in tarnation am I looking at?! Wh-what is this?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You two seem surprised. I bet
you'll
remember this, won't you? It's not
a sight you're
likely to forget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan has made something she
calls
"stargazy pie." It's a unique dish
which has fish
heads poking out of it so
they're staring upwards!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the fish pretty all lined up like
this? The
potato filling is creamy and
delicious too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? What's wrong, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. This is really something...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! This dish is a dilly and a
humdinger all at
once! I just can't wait to
dig in!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Help yourselves. And when you think of
me, think
of this pie as well. Please don't
forget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's pie makes a startling
impression.
Incidentally, it also tastes
incredibly delicious.
